faqs.question: What is the puriFlash XS 530 used for?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash XS 530 is a compact semi-prep flash purification system that runs normal or reverse phase separations at 300 mL/min and 30 bar. It uses 20mm or 30mm ID columns and is built for high-throughput labs with limited bench space.

faqs.question: What is UPFP in the puriFlash XS 530?
faqs.answer: UPFP stands for Ultra Performance Flash Purification, the design approach behind the puriFlash XS 530's faster run times. Shorter runs use less solvent, which also speeds up the downstream evaporation step in the lab workflow.

faqs.question: What column sizes does the puriFlash XS 530 support?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash XS 530 supports 20mm and 30mm ID preparative columns from the F0004 to F3000 Flash Column range, down to 10μm media. It also supports 15 µm silica columns for higher resolution and increased loading capacity.

faqs.question: Does the puriFlash XS 530 need a fume hood?
faqs.answer: No, the puriFlash XS 530 does not need a fume hood. It has a built-in Fume Encloser, so it can sit anywhere on the bench while keeping the fume hood free for other work.

faqs.question: What detection options does the puriFlash XS 530 offer?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash XS 530 offers standard UV-Vis detection at 200 to 400 nm with multi-wavelength scanning. Optional upgrades include a UV Panorama detector covering 200 to 800 nm and a multifunctional compact mass spectrometer for compound identification.

faqs.question: How does Load & Go injection work on the puriFlash XS 530?
faqs.answer: Load & Go is an automated injection option on the puriFlash XS 530 that loads solid or liquid samples through a multi-way electrical valve. It's available as the 4-ways electrical valve kit and reduces manual handling during high-volume runs.

faqs.question: Can the puriFlash XS 530 run continuously?
faqs.answer: Yes, the puriFlash XS 530 is built for 24/7 operation. It uses high-quality materials designed to lower the total cost of ownership over the system's lifetime.

faqs.question: Can the puriFlash XS 530 be controlled remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, the puriFlash XS 530 can be started remotely using its controller, and a companion smartphone app converts TLC or HPLC methods into a purification gradient in one click.

faqs.question: What is Dry-Load technology on the puriFlash 5.030?

faqs.question: What automation does the puriFlash 5.030 include?

faqs.question: How does Genius AI help on the puriFlash 5.030?

faqs.question: How many columns and racks does the puriFlash 5.030 support?

sections.title: Automation and Safety Features
body: This section covers how RFID detection, leak sensors, and solvent monitoring work together on the puriFlash 5.030.
Every part of a purification run gets a layer of automated oversight here, so fewer things depend on catching a mistake manually.

RFID detection identifies columns, racks, and Dry-Load the moment they're loaded, cutting down on setup errors. Leak sensors sit throughout the instrument, watching for problems before they reach your compounds, which matters most when a sample took several synthesis steps to make. Solvent levels are tracked continuously, and the ClearPeak software pauses the method automatically rather than letting a column run dry. Dry-Load preparation is timed to fit inside the equilibration phase, so automating solid injection doesn't add time to your day.

body: Detection here starts strong and scales up through three separate, addable packs, depending on what your samples need.

Standard detection covers UV-Vis at 200 to 400 nm with multi-wavelength and collection scan. From there, the Pack UVextended widens coverage to a full 200 to 800 nm panoramic view. The Pack iELSD adds an integrated evaporative light scattering detector for chromophore-free compounds that UV alone would miss. And the system supports mass detection as part of a triple-mode setup, so UV, ELSD, and mass can work together to make sure nothing slips through.

faqs.question: What is the puriFlash 5.050 used for?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash 5.050 is a cross-over flash and preparative purification system built for more demanding separations. It runs at 250 mL/min and up to 50 bar, moving between normal and reverse phase on reusable stainless steel columns.

faqs.question: How is the puriFlash 5.050 different from a standard flash system?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash 5.050 bridges flash chromatography and preparative HPLC in one instrument, reaching up to 50 bar for preparative-scale separations while still supporting routine flash purification. Standard flash systems typically stop at flash-scale pressure and column sizes.

faqs.question: What column sizes does the puriFlash 5.050 support?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash 5.050 supports preparative columns up to 80mm (3") ID and flash columns from F0004 to F3000. It's designed for reusable stainless steel columns filled with low particle size phases.

faqs.question: Why does the puriFlash 5.050 use reusable stainless steel columns?
faqs.answer: Reusable stainless steel columns on the puriFlash 5.050 are the preferred choice for complex reverse-phase reprocessing. They also support a more ecological approach to purification by reducing consumable column waste.

faqs.question: What detection options does the puriFlash 5.050 offer?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash 5.050 offers standard UV-Vis detection at 200 to 400 nm as its base configuration. Optional upgrades include the Pack UVextended for 200 to 800 nm coverage, the Pack iELSD for chromophore-free compounds, and mass detection for a full triple-mode setup.

faqs.question: How does Genius AI work on the puriFlash 5.050?
faqs.answer: Genius AI is built into the puriFlash 5.050's ClearPeak software and recommends the best purification method and column directly from a TLC plate. A free smartphone app can also transfer a photographed TLC plate straight to Genius and attach it to the report.

faqs.question: How does the puriFlash 5.050 protect against solvent and leak issues?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash 5.050 uses level detectors to pause the system before a column runs dry or a waste container overflows. Multiple leak detectors are also built into the device to guard against product loss.

faqs.question: How many columns and racks does the puriFlash 5.050 support?
faqs.answer: The puriFlash 5.050 supports 3 long racks holding 132 test tubes, alongside its full range of flash and preparative column compatibility.

faqs.question: What is the price of the puriFlash 5.050 in India?
faqs.answer: The price of the puriFlash 5.050 in India depends on the column, detection, and automation packages selected. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the puriFlash 5.050 in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Advion Interchim Scientific puriFlash 5.050 in India. Inkarp provides demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

body.text: It bridges flash chromatography and preparative HPLC in one system, moving between normal and reverse phase without switching instruments.
A max pressure of 50 bar opens up preparative-scale separations while still supporting flash purification on the same device.
Reusable stainless steel columns, filled with low particle size phases, are the preferred choice for complex reverse-phase reprocessing.
Wash discs protect the pump from crystallization, letting water circulate behind the pump heads when an additive in your purification could otherwise crystallize.
RFID technology automatically recognizes columns, racks, and injection loops as you load them, so methods build themselves without manual searching.
Triple detection across UV, mass, and ELSD means no compound is missed, keeping purification yield optimal.
Level detectors watch solvent bottles and waste containers, pausing the system before a column runs dry or a container overflows.
Multiple leak detectors are built into the device to guard against loss throughout the purification.
Genius AI, part of the ClearPeak software, recommends the best purification method and column directly from a TLC plate, and a smartphone app can transfer that TLC photo straight into the report.
Remote monitoring lets you keep an eye on a purification while you're working on something else.

sections.title: Reusable Columns and Reverse-Phase Purification
sections.tabSummary: Stainless steel columns and ecological purification
body: This section covers how the puriFlash 5.050's stainless steel columns support complex reverse-phase separations.
Complex separations often call for equipment that can handle repeated, demanding reprocessing, and that's where the reusable column approach earns its place here.

Stainless steel columns filled with low particle size phases are the preferred choice for successful reverse-phase separations on the puriFlash 5.050, particularly for more complex reprocessing work. Because these columns are reusable rather than disposable, the system also takes a more ecological approach to purification overall. Wash discs support that same durability goal, letting water circulate behind the pump heads to guard against crystallization when a purification involves an additive prone to it.

groups.title: Detection and Safety Systems
groups.summary: Triple detection, leak protection, solvent monitoring
groups.description: This section covers the puriFlash 5.050's triple detection and built-in protection against solvent and leak issues.
body: Detection and protection work together here, so a missed compound and a damaged run are both accounted for by design.

Triple detection across UV, mass, and ELSD is available to make sure no compound goes undetected, keeping purification yield high even for chromophore-free compositions with the optional iELSD pack. Beyond compound detection, level detectors watch both solvent bottles and the waste container, pausing the system before a column can run dry or a container can overflow. Multiple leak detectors sit throughout the device as an additional safeguard against product loss.
rows: Detecting all compounds, including chromophore-free ones
Automatic solvent level detection and pause
